يتعجرفون (form IIq)
# يَتَعَجْرَفُونَ (yataʕajrafūna) /ja.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# يُتَعَجْرَفُونَ (yutaʕajrafūna) /ju.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
